List setting values for specific keys. Credentials are masked: the credentials in any proxy, webhook or authentication server URL and the values of custom webhook headers read back as "******", and encrypted secrets are returned as booleans. A masked value is not the stored one - POST /v1/settings skips it when it matches the stored value and refuses it otherwise.
